goal: Preserve an enrolled /immune-brain:drive session entry token across non-terminal user-wait pauses on the same bound (workspace, batch_id | run_id) across Claude Code, Pi, and Antigravity, reset consecutive native_failures to 0 when start_unattended_batch returns state === "started", and amend ADR 0025 §3/§6 while keeping all terminal revocations and Host Native Gates intact, per D1 of docs/specs/workflow-friction-simplification.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source BR-DEC-1; meet D1.1 and BR-SCN-1 in docs/specs/workflow-friction-simplification.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/run-continuation.test.ts, tests/claude-run-continuation.test.ts, tests/pi-run-continuation.test.ts, tests/antigravity-assurance-conformance.test.ts. Done looks like: when an enrolled batch or task run yields for user input (!runnable && !executors_running) on the same workspace, continuation suspends without revoking entry_token, a plain-text non-cancelling/non-planning user prompt clears suspension so subsequent immune-brain MCP calls proceed without run_entry_required across Claude, Pi, and Antigravity, and docs/adr/0025-run-entry-decision-hosting.md §3/§6 documents user-wait suspension versus revocation. Negative: settled runs, SessionEnd, workspace drift, explicit cancel (releasesRunBinding), /draw-up or /clarify entry, review_incomplete, and the 7-stop runaway limit still revoke entry_token and refuse subsequent token-backed MCP calls with run_entry_required; Native Gates remain required.

Source BR-REQ-1; meet D1.2 in docs/specs/workflow-friction-simplification.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/run-continuation.test.ts, tests/claude-run-continuation.test.ts, tests/antigravity-assurance-conformance.test.ts. Done looks like: two failed or rejected start_unattended_batch calls followed by a start_unattended_batch response with state === "started" reset metadata.native_failures to 0, allowing up to two subsequent failures before hitting NATIVE_FAILURE_LIMIT. Negative: three consecutive failed or non-applied native operations without an intervening state === "started" still revoke entry_token and pause the session.
